findings.resolution: Each exact BASE/CANDIDATE tree independently supplies exactly one DX descriptor at arbitrary repository depth; no caller locator or working-directory heuristic can narrow selection.
Declared packages resolve relative to the descriptor while every repository file remains in the disposition receipt and out-of-root lookalikes remain explicitly non-applicable.
Descriptor and package locators enforce canonical repository-relative paths, the pinned byte bound, portable aliases and reserved names, and case-independent duplicate and overlap refusal.
Descriptor relocation is evaluated independently per side; semantic identity remains stable while exact owner provenance and side receipts rotate.
The capability truthfully supports one DX descriptor at arbitrary depth and fails closed rather than selecting among multiple projects.
